meta.description: Build volcano and MA plots from differential-expression results with LFC shrinkage, FDR thresholds, label placement and axis conventions across EnhancedVolcano, ggplot2 and matplotlib; ships volcano_phd.R, volcano_plot.R and ma_plot.py.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values: counts (451 Up / 366 Down at padj<0.05 and |LFC|>1; 3,994 padj<0.05) equal independent recomputation on the airway dds.

practice_boundaries.detail: Visualization skill; no clinical or prescriptive output.

methodological_ground.detail: Shrinkage and FDR guidance is sound; the shipped plots draw an FDR line on a raw-p axis and clip significant points (VOL-001, VOL-002), filed as defects with fixes, not inverted conclusions.

code_usability.detail: All three scripts ran on airway with exit 0 and correct counts; defects are plot-content bugs (VOL-001..VOL-003, VOL-008).

functional_suitability.note: Strong method content (shrinkage, s-value, label rank); the headline volcano_phd.R clips 49 significant genes and mis-draws the threshold (VOL-001, VOL-002).

reliability.note: Runs cleanly but requires a pre-built dds and fails silently on clipped data and on EnhancedVolcano colouring (VOL-001, VOL-003).

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is long (11.6 KB) with repeated points across SKILL, usage-guide, failure-modes and reconciliation; references are routed.

agent_usability.note: Operational read-order rule is helpful, but its own rule 3 (threshold matches axis) fails for the shipped script (VOL-002).

human_usability.note: Readable tips; several factual statements are wrong or stale (VOL-004..VOL-007).

security.note: Local reads and writes only; no credentials or network.

maintainability.note: Scripts duplicate the volcano logic with drifting behaviour (cap, colours); no tests.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, decision tables and failure modes; several claims did not reproduce on current DESeq2 and EnhancedVolcano.

key_strengths: Counts, labels and shrinkage behaviour reproduced exactly on the real airway dataset.
volcano_plot() produces a clean, legible Okabe-Ito volcano with combined-rank labels.
The decision content (apeglm vs ashr, s-value approximation, apeglm needs coef=) is largely verified against current DESeq2 1.46.

recommendations.title: VOL-001 volcano_phd.R clips significant points and their labels with an unconditional y cap
recommendations.problem: coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50)) is applied regardless of the data: 49 significant genes (max -log10 p 135.7) vanish and 9 of 13 labels, including the top-ranked genes, pile at the top edge; the usage-guide says capped points remain visible at the edge.
recommendations.root_cause: The optional cap is hard-coded and coord_cartesian clips rather than squishes points.
recommendations.fix: Apply the cap only when requested (y_cap = NULL by default), or squish with pmin(neg_log10_p, y_cap) plus a marker/axis break, and state the cap in the caption.

recommendations.title: VOL-002 Shipped volcanoes draw the FDR line on a raw-p axis, contradicting the Skill
recommendations.problem: Both R scripts plot -log10(pvalue) and draw the hline at -log10(fdr): line at 1.301, smallest coloured point at 2.015; SKILL.md says drawing the FDR line on raw p 'creates a meaningless line' and operational rule 3 asks that the line match the axis.
recommendations.root_cause: Raw-p axis kept while the FDR threshold is projected; the script comment calls it approximate.
recommendations.fix: Plot -log10(padj) on y (as for EnhancedVolcano) or draw the line at the smallest -log10(p) among padj < fdr genes and label it.

recommendations.title: VOL-003 EnhancedVolcano example loses direction and mislabels the axis
recommendations.problem: col = c('grey60','#0072B2','#56B4E9','#D55E00') colours all 451 Up and 366 Down genes the same orange (class FC_P), against 'color by direction' and the ggplot volcano; y = 'padj' is labelled '-Log10 P'.
recommendations.root_cause: EnhancedVolcano classes are NS / FC / P / FC_P, not Up/Down/NS.
recommendations.fix: Use colCustom per direction or document that EnhancedVolcano colours by class; set ylab = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~italic(P)).

recommendations.title: VOL-004 ashr is said to return svalue; it does not
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md says lfcShrink(type='ashr') returns an svalue column and the usage-guide says to use ashr for s-values; DESeq2 1.46 ashr returns baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, pvalue, padj only. s-values come from lfcShrink(type='apeglm', svalue = TRUE).
recommendations.root_cause: Version-dependent claim not checked on the current API.
recommendations.fix: State that svalue comes from apeglm with svalue=TRUE (or from ashr::ash lfsr) and correct the decision-tree row.

recommendations.title: VOL-005 sanbomics.tools.volcano does not exist
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md names sanbomics.tools.volcano; the function is sanbomics.plots.volcano and sanbomics.tools fails to import without pkg_resources.
recommendations.fix: Name sanbomics.plots.volcano (and note the optional dependency) or drop the mention.

recommendations.title: VOL-006 EnhancedVolcano selectLab-threshold gotcha does not reproduce
recommendations.problem: Gotcha 1 (repeated in SKILL.md, failure-modes.md, usage-guide, the script comment and the error table) says selectLab genes failing pCutoff/FCcutoff are silently unlabeled; on 1.24.0 the failing gene TSPAN6 was labelled.
recommendations.root_cause: Behaviour of an older EnhancedVolcano version carried forward.
recommendations.fix: Remove or version-qualify the gotcha and the manual-layer workaround.

recommendations.title: VOL-007 Shrinkage is described as only pulling toward zero
recommendations.problem: apeglm raised |LFC| for 108 of 29,391 genes and the maximum from 9.51 (MLE) to 10.99 (ALOX15B), while the text says well-estimated genes are 'essentially untouched' and the unshrunken estimate is always the inflated one.
recommendations.root_cause: Simplified description of the apeglm posterior mode.
recommendations.fix: Add a sentence that apeglm uses a different estimator and can exceed the MLE for a few genes; compare against the MLE before reporting extremes.

recommendations.title: VOL-008 Rasterization guidance is not implemented and its size claim is overstated
recommendations.problem: volcano_phd.R comments say to rasterize above 5000 features and that ggsave raster needs ggplot2 3.5+, but no layer is rasterized (volcano.pdf 1.04 MB); '5MB+ PDFs crash Illustrator' is not reproduced (29,391 vector points = 0.45 MB).
recommendations.fix: Wrap the point layer in ggrastr::rasterise or drop the comment; replace '5MB+' with the measured vector/raster ratio.
